title: sdr daily scratchpad - alex martin
content:
Morning plan / context:
- Heavy focus today on enterprise trial follow-ups and resurrecting 2nd-touch accounts from last week.
- Goal: 8 connects, 3 meaningful demos scheduled, clear next steps captured.

Top priority accounts (call order):
1) BrightRoad Health - AE: Priya Shah (targeting demo for region-specific latency improvements). notes: voicemail left 3/2, replied interested but wants quant on p50/p95. Need to send small perf snapshot and ask for 30m.
2) OakLedger (fintech) - AE: Marco Li. notes: Legal pinged about private deployment. Flag for AE + Solutions. Cold call + LinkedIn InMail queued 9:30am.
3) NovaRetail - AE: Jordan Blake. notes: Did discovery last week, POC request. Need to push for a slot next Wed. send calendar options.
4) AeroSync - small: follow up on trial credits. quick call to unblock infra questions.
5) AtlasEd - outreach to EIR. low priority but good fit for EDU grant.

Call list (script bullets):
- Quick intro + one-sentence value prop: "Redwood helps teams run LLM inference with predictable latency and lower per-token costs, whether hosted or private."
- Pain probe: "How are you handling latency/cost predictability for model inference today? any surprises at scale?"
- If infra/legal: mention Private (VPC/on-prem), KMS/HSM support, audit logs.
- Demo ask: "Would 30 minutes next week to walk through a model profile and perf numbers make sense? I can bring an infra engineer if helpful."

Disposition codes (my shorthand):
- VM = left voicemail + email
- INT = connected, do next-step (demo/intro)
- ETR = email thread, response needed
- NUR = nurture (quarterly)
- NO = not interested

Today outbound schedule (blocks):
- 9:00-10:30 AM - outbound calls + LinkedIn touch
- 10:30-11:00 AM - send perf snapshot + follow-up emails
- 11:00-12:00 PM - discovery with BrightRoad (if booked) / demo prep
- 1:00-3:00 PM - follow-ups and demos
- 3:00-4:00 PM - record notes, update CRM, triage any legal/solutions requests
- 4:00-5:00 PM - plan tomorrow + wrap up

Email templates / snippets (quick paste):
- Quick follow-up after VM: "Hi {Name}, left a quick voicemail—wanted to share a short perf snapshot showing p50/p95 and cost delta when batching + prefix caching enabled. Can we grab 30m next week to walk through? Cheers, Alex."
- For legal/private interest: "We support Private deploys (VPC/on-prem) with KMS integration and audit logs. Happy to set up an intro with our Solutions Engineer to discuss compliance requirements."

Notes to CRM (things to log):
- BrightRoad: send perf snapshot + set reminder 3/6. If no reply, escalate to AE for warm intro.
- OakLedger: flag for Solutions + Legal. Attach compliance checklist link.
- NovaRetail: propose Wed/Thu 11am-2pm windows.

Open items / blockers:
- Need updated perf snapshot template from eng (pinged eng @observability channel last week). If not available, build quick export from the public benchmarks and annotate.
- OakLedger legal wants a redacted SOC2 excerpt — check with security to get a CYA copy.

Follow-ups to do today (tick when done):
- [ ] Send perf snapshot to BrightRoad + calendar options
- [ ] InMail + call OakLedger 9:30am
- [ ] Draft intro for Solutions for OakLedger + attach compliance checklist
- [ ] Propose NovaRetail demo slots
- [ ] Update CRM with call dispositions and notes

Quick wins / playbook reminders:
- Mention batching + KV cache savings for high-throughput apps (customers care about $/1M tokens).
- Use case that resonates: multi-tenant SaaS with strict p95 latency budgets (call out p50 vs p95).
- When legal asks, speed is key — get SE + security looped same day.

Brainstorm fragments (scratch):
- Could run a "latency spotlight" sequence for accounts with >100k tokens/month estimate. Short two-email sequence: perf snapshot + invite to 30m technical review.
- Try AB test subject lines for perf snapshot emails: "Redwood perf snapshot for {company} — 2min" vs "Quick numbers: p95 latency + cost opportunities"

Misc notes / random: 
- Slack threads to reference: #gtm-outreach, #observability (perf snapshot convo), #security-requests (oakledger SOC ask).
- JIRA: ENGINF-4521 (perf snapshot tooling backlog)
- Confluence playbook: gtm-playbook/sales-sequences (link in metadata)

End-of-day checklist:
- update CRM, close loop on any legal threads, post summary to #sdr-daily-standup if notable connects/demos scheduled.
